subject: Purchase order number issuance and updated spend limit for Skyline Cloud onboarding
messages:
From: Skyline Cloud Ops <ops@skylinecloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Skyline Billing <billing@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + onboarding docs needed for Redwood account

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. To get Skyline provisioning onto Redwood Dedicated I need the following from your side so procurement can issue the PO and our billing team can map invoices:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (W-9 equivalent + bank details)
- Target annual spend/signed spend cap for the first 12 months
- Exact SKU / line-item mapping for the three service blocks we discussed (dedicated pool, burst, support)

If you can send a filled onboarding PDF and confirm the spend cap, I can route the PO number internally and get a credit hold lifted. We prefer PO numbers before any provisioning.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Operations Manager
Skyline Cloud

Attachment: onboarding_form_template.pdf (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Skyline Cloud Ops <ops@skylinecloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding docs needed for Redwood account

On Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 10:15 AM Skyline Cloud Ops <ops@skylinecloud.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the kickoff call this morning. To get Skyline provisioning onto Redwood Dedicated I need the following from your side so procurement can issue the PO and our billing team can map invoices:
>
> - Completed vendor onboarding form (W-9 equivalent + bank details)
> - Target annual spend/signed spend cap for the first 12 months
> - Exact SKU / line-item mapping for the three service blocks we discussed (dedicated pool, burst, support)
>
> If you can send a filled onboarding PDF and confirm the spend cap, I can route the PO number internally and get a credit hold lifted.

Hi Lena —

Attaching the completed onboarding form (filled by our vendor operations). For the initial engagement we are proposing a contractual spend cap of USD 120,000 for the 12‑month term, with a separate overage bucket to be handled as monthly overages (we'll treat those as billable and on-net per usage if the cap is exceeded).

Line-item notes (please confirm):
- "Dedicated GPU pool - standard" -> SKU: RIF-GP-DED-1 (monthly metered)
- "Burst capacity (ephemeral)" -> SKU: RIF-GP-BST (per-minute)
- "Priority support (SLA)" -> SKU: RIF-SUP-P1 (monthly)

We found a mismatch in one of your sample invoices where "GPU burst" was split across two line items; can you consolidate that into a single SKU as above so finance can map it to the PO cleanly?

Priyom / Marcus — tagging procurement and finance to start PO issuance. Ideally we get a PO number (or draft) this week so Skyline can begin provisioning.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Skyline_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Skyline Cloud Ops <ops@skylinecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding docs needed for Redwood account

Thanks Rishi — forwarding to finance for final approval.

I created a draft PO (PO-678912 draft) that reflects the requested spend cap of $120,000/yr and maps the three SKUs you listed. Please review the attached draft and confirm the consolidated SKU name for "Burst capacity" so we can finalize the line items.

Notes in the draft:
- Spend cap field: $120,000 yearly (overage billing to be handled as separate invoices)
- Billing contact: billing@skylinecloud.com
- PO valid for 30 days from issuance unless countersigned SOW attached

Lena — if the SKU consolidation is confirmed I can mark this ready for Marcus to sign and release a PO number.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_PO_678912.pdf (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Skyline Cloud Ops <ops@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final PO issuance: PO-678912 (approved)

Priyom / Rishi / Lena —

Reviewed and approved. Finance is issuing the formal PO number with the agreed spend parameters:

- PO number: PO-678912
- Spend cap: USD 120,000 (12-month term)
- Overage handling: invoices submitted monthly and paid per standard net-30; overages not to exceed 20% of cap without prior written approval
- Line items (final):
  1) RIF-GP-DED-1 — Dedicated GPU pool (monthly)
  2) RIF-GP-BST — Burst capacity (per-minute)
  3) RIF-SUP-P1 — Priority support (monthly)

Two procedural items:
1) We need a one-page SOW that enumerates estimated baseline usage per SKU (for forecast accuracy). Please upload to the shared drive and include the link in your invoice header.
2) Legal will do a quick counter-signature on the SOW. This PO will be effective upon countersigned SOW.

I've attached the finalized PO PDF. Lena — please confirm SKU consolidation and upload the SOW when ready; we will remove the credit hold once countersign is complete.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: finalized_PO_678912.pdf (stub)

From: Skyline Cloud Billing <billing@skylinecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final PO issuance: PO-678912 (approved)

Marcus / Priyom / Rishi —

Received — thank you. We confirm SKU consolidation: RIF-GP-BST will be used for all burst billing (we will not split across lines). We will upload a one-page SOW by EOD tomorrow and include the shared Drive link in the invoice metadata.

Next steps on our side:
- Upload SOW: 2026-08-04 by 17:00 PT (shared Drive link to follow)
- Countersign: once you send the finalized SOW, we will countersign and return within 48 hours
- Provisioning: we will queue the Dedicated pool immediately after countersigned SOW; expected ramp within 3 business days post-countersign

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Chris Holden
Billing Lead
Skyline Cloud

Attachment: none
